top_signals.title: Brick-and-Mortar Making a Comeback on Experience, Says Dana Telsey
top_signals.summary:
Black Friday got off to a gloomy start on the East Coast, as the stormy weather that postponed the Macy’s Thanksgiving Parade dragged into the early morning and subdued lines for some of the biggest in-person deals of the year.
Dana Telsey, CEO at Telsey Advisory Group, discusses how retail is shaping up heading into the Black Friday shopping weekend. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: AI shopping agents from OpenAI, Meta, Google and Instinct promise to help users shop, but they're hitting roadblocks at Amazon and other retailers.

top_signals.title: Trump demands probe into 'record setting error' after third-quarter GDP data gets massive revision higher
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump on Thursday deemed the latest gross domestic product revision a mistake, claiming that it should be "immediately investigated."
